name: pop-quiz
description: Two short questions about Claude's latest code change, answers one press away. Off by default.

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Switch pop-quiz off without uninstalling it. The modmyclaude hub flips this too.

startOn.title: On from the start
startOn.description: Quiz in every session without typing /pop-quiz on. Each quiz is one small-model call (about $0.0004 at list prices).

every.title: Quiz every n changed turns
every.description: 1 quizzes every turn that changed files; 3 (the default) every third. 1 to 20.
